relations.subject: Louis Finot
relations.evidence: Finot was admitted to the École Nationale des Chartes in 1886. He left it two years later with the title of palaeographer.

relations.subject: Louis Finot
relations.evidence: He worked initially as a trainee then as an assistant librarian with the French National Library

relations.subject: Louis Finot
relations.evidence: In 1898, he was named director of the archaeological mission in Indochina, which would become in 1900 the Ecole française d'Extrême-Orient (EFEO).

relations.subject: Louis Finot
relations.evidence: In 1933 he became a member of the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres.
